description: Multi-timeframe technical-analysis snapshot for one coin, computed locally from real candles (not a vendor black box): per interval — last close, RSI(14), EMA20/50/200 + SMA200, MACD(12,26,9) with signal/histogram/cross freshness, ATR(14) with 2xATR stop suggestions (feed risk_position_size), Bollinger(20,2) with %B and bandwidth, ADX(14) with +DI/-DI, volume vs 20-candle average, and a transparent trend rule (EMA alignment qualified by ADX). 'intervals' picks the timeframes (default 1h,4h,1d; max 4 of 1m|5m|15m|30m|1h|4h|12h|1d|1w); 'market' routes candles (spot|perp|auto, default auto: spot preferred, perp fallback). AltFINS vendor support/resistance levels are appended when that feed is up.

intervals.description: Candle intervals to analyze, e.g. ["4h","1d"]. Default ["1h","4h","1d"]; max 4 of 1m|5m|15m|30m|1h|4h|12h|1d|1w

market.description: Which candle series: 'spot', 'perp', or 'auto' (default: spot preferred, perp fallback)

name: ta_technicals

altFins.description: Vendor levels enrichment; omitted when the AltFINS feed is down

failedIntervals.description: Intervals that could not be analyzed, with reasons

lastPriceUsd.description: Newest close of the finest analyzed timeframe

asOfMs.description: Open time of the newest closed candle, Unix epoch ms

atr14Pct.description: ATR(14) as % of last close — stop-sizing form

bandwidthPct.description: Band width as % of middle — squeeze measure

percentB.description: Close inside the band: 0 = lower, 1 = upper

droppedPartialCandle.description: True when a still-forming newest candle was excluded

candlesSinceCross.description: 1 = crossed on the newest closed candle; omitted when no cross in window

histogram.description: macd - signal; sign is the cross state

rsi14.description: Wilder RSI, 0-100; omitted without 15 closed candles

trend.description: Transparent rule: EMA alignment qualified by ADX

title: Technical Analysis
